title: manifest: honor --compression-level with podman-remote push
body:
Running `podman --remote manifest push --compression-level` did not use the given level. The option was never sent to the server, so it was silently ignored. This passes the option to the server, the same way `podman push` already does, and adds a test that runs in remote mode too. The test fails without this fix and passes with it.

```release-note
Fixed `podman --remote manifest push` ignoring `--compression-level`.
```
